source.characterRule: Use canonical on-chain Generations sprites through the SDK sprite reader. Preserve integer pixel edges and the white outline.

loadingRules.void: Subtract this chunk from the top and floor texture. Show only a subtle dotted guide if needed.
loadingRules.wireframe: Subtract the chunk; show an open green isometric outline with sparse node corners, no fill.
loadingRules.floating: Subtract the chunk; draw a separate white/dither unfinished tile lifted by lift screen pixels with a slim green guide.
loadingRules.occlusion: Mask all floor paths and texture to the actual loaded surface. Do not leave upright actors or props anchored over a missing chunk.
